caveats: Final source correctness, protected files, actual candidate checking, AST write route and supported final claims are separate gates; every attempt remains in the denominator.

Control forwards the original report. Treatment factors only identical whitelisted per-file metadata into fileDefaults, retaining all original JSON facts, inline diffs and warnings. Single-file reports remain byte-identical. The native Bash tool removes the final newline. No reviewContext or source snapshot is added.

Factoring shared per-file values does not merge actual check executions or turn per-file validation into a global or semantic verdict. Original and presented reports, mode, argv-derived eligibility, reconstruction and native delivery are checked separately.

Repeated check executions count each equivalent php check.php execution after integrated project success on unchanged inputs; containing Bash calls are reported separately. Different checks, lint and Git reads are not equivalent check executions.
Native Read counts cover successfully returned known files. Other Bash commands are preserved for review rather than silently counted as native Reads. Reading an unresolved warning may be warranted.
Intermediate false statements are retained separately and do not fail the final-only claim gate when the final corrects or omits them.

The small-task printer adds a final newline; four changed cross-file PHP files lose a trailing blank line. These deterministic formatter effects are in the retained diff, separate from rename correctness.
The preserved checker contains semantic old-method references in a negative assertion or fallback. Correct preservation does not imply those strings are semantically unrelated.
These tasks do not establish policy compliance on failed, missing, stale or differently scoped checks, or an explicit requirement for fresh independent execution.
